name: cuad-clauses
description: Seven clause questions that map one to one onto CUAD v1 categories, so a batch over CUAD contracts can be scored against the experts' spans (docs/CUAD.md). Each is an ordinary question run; the value is the first finding whose citation verified.

fields.label: Governing law
fields.question: What law governs this agreement and where must disputes be brought?

fields.label: Termination for convenience
fields.question: May either party terminate this agreement for convenience, without cause, and on what notice?

fields.label: Liability cap
fields.question: What is the cap on each party's liability?

fields.label: Uncapped liability
fields.question: Which liabilities are excluded from the cap or left uncapped?

fields.label: Non-compete
fields.question: Does this agreement restrict either party from competing with the other, and how?

fields.label: Change of control
fields.question: What happens to this agreement if a party undergoes a change of control?

fields.label: Most favoured nation
fields.question: Is there a most favoured nation clause?
